_comment: A recorded reply from OCR.space's parse/image endpoint, shaped exactly as
the service sends it, for the invented poster in example-retreat-poster.png.
This is a recording, not a live call: the test suite must never depend on a
third-party service, on a key, or on a local Tesseract install. The text is
what a human reads off the fixture image, including the OCR quirks a real
engine produces (a lowercase town, a phone number read as words), so the
replay exercises the same shape of noisy input a live call would return.
No real parish data: Example Parish, Example Parish Hall and the
021 555 0100 number are all reserved for fixtures.
